name: Animahl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Animahl in Tirol!**

Discover the wild side of the **Tirol** with **Animahl** – a unique adventure park where you can get up close and personal with fascinating animals from all over the world. Whether you're a family, a couple, or traveling solo, **Animahl** offers unforgettable experiences for every age.

**Meet the Animals**
Encounter exotic species like **African lions**, playful **Asian elephants**, majestic **Andean condors**, and many more. With over **100 different animal species**, every visit is a new discovery.

**Thrilling Experiences**
Dare to feed the **African lions** or stroke a **meerkat**? Try your hand at **horseback riding** or take a **quad bike tour** through the park. For the brave, there’s even a **zip line** with a breathtaking view over the **Tiroler Alps**.

**Family Fun**
Kids and adults alike will love the **petting zoo**, where they can meet friendly animals like **sheep**, **goats**, and **ponies**. Don’t miss the **animal shows** with exciting performances by **eagles**, **parrots**, and **sea lions**.

**Culinary Delights**
After your adventure, relax at one of the park’s restaurants and enjoy regional specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a refreshing **Apfelstrudel**. Pair your meal with a local **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of **Graubündner wine**.

**Location & Opening Hours**
**Animahl** is located just outside **Innsbruck**, near the **Hafnerberg**, making it easily accessible by car or public transport. The park is open daily from **9:00 AM to 6:00 PM** (last entry at **5:00 PM**), with extended hours in summer.

**Plan Your Visit**
Check the **Animahl** website for up-to-date information on **tickets**, **special events**, and **guided tours**. Whether you're exploring the **Zillertal**, **Ötztal**, or **Lech-Zürs**, **Animahl** is the perfect stop for animal lovers and adventure seekers.

**Come and experience the magic of wildlife in the heart of Tirol!**
